name: smartypants
description: Keeps a Mermaid-style system diagram and a compact memory of your architectural intent while an agent codes, goes deeper on any part on request, and flags where the code drifts from the intent.

typesafe_api_key.title: Typesafe (Jev) API key (optional alternative)
typesafe_api_key.description: Only used with "decider": "jev" in smartypants.config.json: Jev answers the per-turn questions in ~0.2 s instead of Claude Sonnet 5.5. Create a key at https://console.typesafe.ai/keys.

meta_api_key.title: Meta Model API key (only for the meta flavor)
meta_api_key.description: Only needed if smartypants.config.json sets "flavor": "meta" (Muse Spark on api.meta.ai). The default claude flavor uses this machine's Claude Code sign-in and needs no key here.
